digest.component_or_area: completion evidence banking oracle and observer
propositions: The 0707 dense-banking eval fails when it filters bank writes by source=='tool', missing the policy's fallback snapshots that fire at bounded evidence-response intervals [2,5,8,...]
Post-commit e1352535ace, the model's voluntary banking cadence no longer enforces interleaved records; the policy's per-criterion 3-response fallback snapshots are the durable safety mechanism

The observer's make_observed_upsert must record the first durable bank write of each criterion regardless of source (genuine model record OR policy fallback snapshot), excluding only cache seeds marked seeded=True
The oracle must validate system-level boundedness by asserting all durable banking events are recorded at bounded intervals, not just model-initiated writes
